label: Generic Tax Data
notes: Vendor-neutral: every fact the export vocabulary declares, named as we
name it, with the engine's own unrounded amounts. This is the target to
hand someone who has not yet said what their tax package imports.
A real vendor map adds a sibling file here with an explicit 'fields'
table; it needs no Python change. Omitting 'fields' means the full
vocabulary, which is why this file does not restate it.
